latestVersion.changelog:
Podcast Video Recording Software v1.0.0

- Initial release: Convert audio/video files (MP4, MOV, WAV, MP3) into polished podcast videos up to 500MB each, with fast AI processing on cloud GPUs.
- Supports 1080p MP4 exports, waveform animation, captions, speaker labels, and timeline-based editing.
- Automatic authentication handling via NEMO_TOKEN, with easy setup for new users.
- File upload, timeline editing, video export, status, and credits check workflows via chat commands.
- Full error handling for session, file, credit, and export issues, with clear user feedback.
- Designed for quick turnarounds (1–3 minutes per job) and optimized for shareable social content.
